today.liveTrackingPaused: Live status tracking is paused. Quick status changes below are disabled — log this period via <askAi>Ask LogbookAI</askAi> or <logs>Logs</logs> instead.
today.timelineCorrectionRequired: HOS unavailable until your log is complete
today.timelineCorrectionRequiredHelp: Your timeline has a missing or overlapping segment, so HOS values can't be calculated yet. Edit the log to correct the timeline.
today.noInspectionToday: No inspection report logged today yet.
today.vehicleUnsafe: Vehicle should not be operated if unsafe.
today.dvirReminder: Reminder: review vehicle condition before finishing your work period and report any defects.
today.cycleAvailabilityNote: Cycle availability based only on records entered in LogbookAI. Prior duty history was not provided, so cycle balance is not verified until enough history exists to cover your {{cycleDays}} cycle.

settings.languageDescription: Choose the app's display language. Ask LogbookAI understands both English and Spanish either way — exported PDFs, DVIR/IFTA reports, and certifications always stay in English.

more.title: More
more.aiUsedThisMonth: {{used}} used this month · Voice Log does not count against this
more.appearanceNote: System follows your device setting. Voice Log and basic logging work in any appearance.
more.dvirReminderDescription: Optional. Reminds you near the end of your work period to review vehicle condition. A no-defect written DVIR is not federally required every day for property-carrying CMVs.
more.resetAiUsage: Reset all AI usage this month
more.defaultRuleset: US Interstate Property - Standard Federal Rules
more.deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your LogbookAI data and signs you out. This action cannot be undone.
more.deleteAccountError: Could not delete account. Please try again or contact support.
more.timezoneSuggestionNote: Suggested from your home terminal city. Changing it only affects how times are displayed — your saved log entries are not moved.
more.cycleChangeNote: Changing the cycle will not rewrite prior certified calculations.

trip.title: Trip Planner
trip.intro: Planned activity. Stops here are NOT official RODS until you confirm them when they occur. Pickup and fuel stops auto-fill from your log; edit them to override.
trip.autoAssistDescription: When a trip isn't achievable under current HOS, automatically suggest a rest stop and trip edits. Nothing is applied without your approval.
trip.splitSleeperActiveNote: Split sleeper active — driving & 14-hr window recalculated from the qualifying pairing.
trip.restRequiredNote: Additional qualifying rest will be required before arrival. Do not exceed limits or speed.
trip.routeEstimateError: Route estimate could not be retrieved. Please try again.
trip.limitingClockNote: Limiting clock: {{limiter}} · planning profile {{profile}} · max drivable ~{{miles}} mi.
trip.findingRestStop: Finding a rest stop along your route...
trip.verifiedAreaNote: Approximate area from road routing — confirm a truck-accessible stop before arriving. Named truck-stop verification is a future integration.
trip.unverifiedAreaNote: No named stop verified — plan to stop within this mileage range.
trip.planFitsNote: This rest plan fits within your currently calculated HOS availability based on the information presently recorded.
trip.planNeedsMoreRestNote: Additional rest will still be needed after this stop to complete the route.
trip.cycleBottleneckNote: Your cycle is the bottleneck and a {{rest}} rest won't recover it. Check that prior days' driving entries are accurate; if a previous driving entry was over-stated, correct it to recover cycle hours. Corrections require your approval before they're applied.
trip.restStopAdded: Rest stop added to your plan below.
trip.suggestedStopsIntro: Based on your current HOS availability, planning speed profile, and the FMCSA 30-minute break / 11-hour driving / 14-hour window / 60-70 hour cycle rules — the same deterministic HOS engine used everywhere else in LogbookAI. Planning suggestions only; not official RODS until you log them.
trip.freshHosFallbackNote: Your current HOS could not be verified from your log (it may be incomplete or contain a gap), so this plan assumes a fresh, fully-rested day — full 11-hour driving / 14-hour window / 8 hours to a qualifying break. It does not assume your 60/70-hour cycle is full, so no restart is suggested. Correct your log for a plan based on your real available hours.
trip.resolvingLocations: Finding real locations along your route…
trip.plannedStopsNote: Planned stops are not official RODS. Confirm with "Log This Event" when they happen.
trip.routeStopAddedNote: {{label}} — ~mile {{mile}} of route ({{reason}}). Planning suggestion — not yet logged.
trip.parkingAvailabilityCheck: Parking availability: Check in Trucker Path
trip.truckerPathRequiresApp: "Check Parking" requires the Trucker Path app installed on this device. LogbookAI does not show live parking availability itself — check Trucker Path for current truck-stop and parking information.
trip.noTruckStopsFound: No named truck stops found near this point from OpenStreetMap. Check Trucker Path directly.

logs.title: Daily Logs
logs.clearDayBody1: This will permanently remove all log events for {{date}}.
logs.clearDayBody2: Events that cross midnight into an adjacent day are split — the adjacent day's records are preserved. Certification for this day is invalidated, and the graph, totals, mileage, HOS, and cycle recap recalculate automatically.
logs.clearDayError: Failed to clear day. Please try again.
logs.saveEventError: Failed to save event. Please try again.
logs.certifiedEditNote: This log is certified. Editing will preserve the previous version in audit history and mark this day as needing re-certification.
logs.endAfterStart: End time must be after the start time.

warnings.timeGapBody: Your log must be continuous. Add a duty record for each missing time slot:
warnings.routeConflictBody: A driving segment is shorter than its route realistically requires. Review the times or locations before certifying.
